high_level_description: This image is the cover of Vogue Korea magazine from March 2018. The cover features a close-up portrait of a person with a blurred face, creating an artistic and mysterious effect. The individual has dark hair and is wearing red lipstick, which stands out against the darker background. The text on the cover includes the magazine's title "VOGUE" in large, bold letters at the top, with "KOREA" written in smaller text above it. Below the title, the names "Kendall JENNER," "BoA," "JANG Keun Suk," and "NCT U" are listed
